notes.title: New Level & Entities Update
notes.notes: [p]Celebrating incoming two year aniversary for the game, this update brings a new extra level "Basement" and two new entities. This update also improves movement, levels and overall gameplay. Below are all the patch notes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Entities[/b][/p][p]Added two new entities[/p][p]Fixed a bug where entity catches the player when it should not be able to[/p][p]Entity in level 1 now follows players over the pitfalls[/p][p]Some of the entities now follow players through doors and might open doors by themselves[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44575883/b14b8faf1e26a0fc7d760149e03cd1a7cbdef9f1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Doors[/b][/p][p]Doors now always open away from the player[/p][p]Updated the look of the doors keeping the same vibe[/p][p]Changed metal door sounds and added door closing sound[/p][p]Fixed wrong door opening when multiple doors are close[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Character[/b][/p][p]Modified jumping mechanic and removed jumping "cooldown"[/p][p]Improved character running animations[/p][p]Added new better running and jumping sounds[/p][p]Modified sanity effect and made sanity last longer[/p][p]Made stamina generate faster[/p][p]Added indicator for low stamina[/p][p]Fixed a bug where spectating players wont automatically change view target when the target dies[/p][p][/p][p][b]Inventory[/b][/p][p]Changed backpack sound and added closing sound[/p][p]Visual improvements such as adding slot numbers and changes to item icon style[/p][p]Fixed inventory bug where it stays on after closing a container[/p][p]Added more visible interact key when looking at items[/p][p]Increased distance where the crosshair is shown when looking at interactable objects[/p][p][/p][p][b]Levels[/b][/p][p]Added new extra level: Basement[/p][p]Added rain and lights to level 4 and fixed and enhanced achievement[/p][p]Added more lights and props to level 6[/p][p]Made level 2 brighter[/p][p]Updated level 5 "toilets" to not stop entities from catching players if the door is open[/p][p]Made some jumps easier in level 7 because of the reduced jumping speed[/p][p]Optimized levels 4, 5 and 10[/p][p]Added markers to the map in level 3 that show players current location and direction[/p][p]Added text that shows if the level is completed in the level selection[/p][p]Made each level to now unlock two new levels, so skipping is possible[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44575883/9aecf522bf456e70e258dc2f428157bcd89ba1d9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Videos[/b][/p][p]Added intro video[/p][p]Added two outro videos[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44575883/572dc9a6a606e1b73b91ea5f363b4d92c2e573de.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]+All kinds of smaller fixes and improvements[/p]

notes.title: Small bugfix #6
notes.notes:
[b]More important changes and fixes:[/b]
Reworked recorder to fix bugs in it
Made loading screen unified with level loading
Removed character falling to the floor when finding the next level
Recreated the map in level 3 to make it easier to read and to make level 3 easier
Added light to checkpoint button to make it easier to see
Fixed visual bug with clients and rising lava at the end of level 7
Fixed a bug in level 3 where you clip through the elevator floor after it comes back up
Changed notes so that multiple players can view them at the same time
Added indicating "battery" to level 2 timerbutton

[b]Other less important:[/b]
Changed level 4 atmosphere
Optimized some entity memory usage
Optimized player character memory usage
Lowered alarm volume
Fixed some bug with the pipe puzzle on level 6
Changed appearance of options and controls because of data loss
Changed appearance of spectator screen
Made first level change more reliable

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44575883/48cc6ce51b2b77673ab2b4f7d9241aa5e0892552.png[/img]
